calibration: Ant Group's official release. Routed experts are MXFP4 (e2m1 weights, e8m0 scales, group size 32, requantised from the FP8 block-128 source); attention, the shared expert, the router, embeddings and lm_head stay FP8 e4m3 block-128 (quantization_config in config.json). The model card publishes per-quant accuracy: GPQA-diamond 83.68, IFBench 73.87, SciCode 38.43, ArcPrize 68.06 (BF16 84.97 / 74.49 / 41.24 / 68.75).
notes: Mixed-precision pack, not uniformly 4-bit: bits is an effective figure (127B of 124B-class parameters sit in the MXFP4 experts; the FP8 remainder and the e8m0 scales lift the average). 24 safetensors shards, 66 GB on disk. Served on a single DGX Spark by SGLang with --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 or humming; the checkpoint does not auto-select an MXFP4 MoE backend. Pairs with the inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-dspark drafter (1.36B, BF16), a speculative draft model passed as an engine argument rather than a quantization of this model.
